results.description:
She refused to break. He refused to let her fight alone.

Josie Mercer has been fighting her whole life. Third-generation owner of a struggling diner in Manitou Springs, she's survived debt collectors, her mother's death, and fifteen years of carrying everything alone. When a predatory loan shark sends his enforcers to shatter her windows and threaten to burn her alive, she does what Mercer women have always done—she refuses to back down.

Summit didn't build Battle Born MC to save damsels in distress. The former Special Forces operator founded his brotherhood to protect the veterans the system forgot—men who survived combat only to be abandoned at home. But when he walks into a boarded-up diner and meets a woman with glass cuts on her face and fire in her eyes, something shifts. She's in his territory. That makes her his to protect.

Whether she likes it or not.

What starts as protection becomes possession. Every look. Every touch. Every moment she proves she's not the kind of woman who breaks under pressure. Josie doesn't need saving—she needs someone willing to stand beside her instead of in front of her. And Summit hasn't let anyone that close in years.

But the men who want her land won't stop until she's dead or destroyed. And Summit won't stop until every last one of them pays in blood.
